inference.seed_rule: 20261109+integer suffix of F01..F12; exact same for all conditions/checkpoints

assignment.method: private HMAC-SHA256 randomized order of 12 prompt IDs selects 6 A=TRIMMED for checkpoint 1024; invert A/B for checkpoint 1280 for each prompt
assignment.private_mapping_escrow: not committed to public GitHub or reviewer packet; SHA commitment here is canonical

rubric.scoring: each continuation 0..3 integer on adherence, coherence, consistency, score only generated content; disregard initial newline/whitespace presentation

adherence.0: No continuation of defining entities, object, or goal
adherence.1: One isolated relevant detail but overall prompt task abandoned
adherence.2: Several central elements retained with partially relevant causal continuation
adherence.3: Main actors, objects and causal goal retained with appropriate continuation

coherence.0: Mostly broken fragments or unrelated dialogue
coherence.1: Some interpretable sentences, little connected progression

consistency.0: Sharp shifts or contradictions in actors/scene/reference
consistency.2: Mostly consistent referents and events with minor lapse

prereg_decision.primary: mean paired adherence delta (trimmed-minus-baseline, 0..3) across 24 pairs
improvement_candidate_requires: trimmed strictly higher adherence in at least 16/24 pairs
adherence mean delta >=0 separately for each checkpoint
coherence and consistency each mean delta >= -0.25
balanced 12/12 A/B and independently frozen reviewer scores before mapping reveal
prereg_decision.robustness: report by checkpoint and per-prompt cluster; 48 outputs are not independent samples because prompts repeat across checkpoints

review_integrity.reviewer_receives: same prompt and normalized A/B continuation only; no checkpoint/condition labels, key, token IDs, probabilities, prior results
review_integrity.freeze_before_unblind: independent reviewer signed scoring receipt and SHA256 recorded on GitHub, then independent key reveal; preserve raw outputs and displayed normalization separately
review_integrity.caution: public GitHub prereg is discoverable and leading-newline effects can reveal condition; never call strictly double-blind
